verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents importing and exporting realms as JSON files, plus a separate export/import for authorization configuration. The Admin REST API, the kcadm.sh CLI and SCIM endpoints give programmatic access to users, groups, roles and clients, and the product runs on the operator's own database (e.g. PostgreSQL), so data can be pulled out in open formats. Evidence is limited to brief doc headings, though. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that realm exports include all users and credentials, an end-user self-service personal data export, independent hands-on corroboration of a full export-and-migrate-away workflow.
